text:
Sam O'Reilly is five games into his NHL career, and the Lightning already look smart for the 2025 trade that sent Isaac Howard to Edmonton for him. The 20-year-old scored his first NHL goal Tuesday against Washington, off what Sportsnet called a beautiful pass from Viel, and has two points in five games on about 12 minutes a night. Tampa Bay is 4-1 with him in the lineup.

He earned the look in junior: 71 points in 56 OHL games for London last season and 8 points in 7 games for Canada at the 2026 World Juniors. Of the 103 forwards picked around 32nd overall since 2005 who have had four-plus seasons, 40 reached 200 NHL games, and their median first real season was 0.32 points a game. He's at 0.40, which in five games means very little.

The early five-on-five picture is mixed (the Lightning have 41.6% of the shot attempts with him on, but a fair share of the expected goals), and he played under nine minutes against his old team Thursday. Our range for him is wide, 17 to 41 points, because five games is almost no evidence.
